proposals: DGCI&S should publish TradeStat import value and quantity in a single file keyed on the same HSN-8 codes, so that every code in a basket can be matched for unit-price analysis rather than 801 of 827, with unmatched codes listed and explained.

DGCI&S should release a downloadable HSN-8 by partner-country import table for Chapters 28 to 39 every year, so that a code falling from one source and rising from another can be separated from genuine domestic substitution before it is called a Scissors Effect.

MoSPI should publish a concordance linking Annual Survey of Industries product codes to HSN-8 for the chemical chapters, so that an import penetration ratio — domestic production against imports — can be computed for each code instead of left out.

DGFT should publish quarterly import values for HSN codes it moves from ‘free’ to ‘restricted’, starting with gold compounds under 28433000, so that the effect of closing a duty loophole is visible and such codes are not mistaken for industrial demand.
